Give the text a flat ground that clears the ratio (a background on its own box), or stop the lines, image or layer behind it short of the text.

1. (Judgment 4/3) At 1440 the lead element is missing from the first fold. `hero_object: list` makes the first project title the lead, but only the "FEATURED — FOUNDER PROJECT" label appears at the bottom edge, and SPACEMAN falls below 900px. The header band is roughly 320px tall against the declared `height_px: 240`, which pushes the index down. Shorten the header and gold plane, or move the index up beside the plane in cols 5–12, so the first title sits fully inside the desktop fold and outranks the maxim.

2. (Judgment 5) The SPACEMAN card says "Travel pricing was a maze of fare classes… a booking engine… what airlines allowed." Nothing like this is in the records. Spaceman is Doug's LLC for independent design and engineering work since 2018. Its clients are Jeffrey Zeldman, Rolex, The Nature Conservancy, Sapient Razorfish, bswift, RTIC Coolers, Framebridge, Intuit, LastPass and WorkAround. Replace the card copy with text drawn from the record.

3. (Judgment 5) Several index taglines contradict the records:
   - "FishSticks — workflow tooling": the record describes a spelling-practice app for kids.
   - "TeeTurn — tee-time swaps": the record describes real-time round-progress tracking, with Doug responsible for product direction.
   - "Twittertale — narrative feeds": the record describes a swear-word ranking built on the public timeline.
   - "Politweets — election sentiment": the record describes real-time candidate mentions styled as a newspaper.
   - "15th Club — caddie intelligence": the record describes AI experiments through golf, starting with a scorecard.
   
   Rewrite each tagline from its record.

4. (Judgment 5) The role line reads "DESIGN ENGINEER". The identity record gives the role as "Product Designer & Developer". Use the recorded role.

5. (Judgment 2) The justified maxim at 1440 leaves huge gaps on line 2, "THAT   HANDLED   STRESS", which breaks the reading line. Adjust the measure, tracking or hyphenation so the justification sets evenly, as i

1. Judgment 4: At 360 the lead element, the SPACEMAN index title, is cut by the bottom of fold 1. The fold ends on "2018 · Founder / SPACEMAN LLC", and the title starts clipped at the top of fold 2. Set the SPACEMAN title directly under the "Featured — Founder Project" label, ahead of its year/role line, and trim the mobile header band and the index-heading gap. The whole title must sit inside fold 1, below the gold maxim plane the Mobile Declaration names.

1. Freshness: This reads as a rerun of 2026-10-17, "an index-specimen under a violet masthead, the work flushed…". Both pages use the same irregular-twelve, vertical, right-weighted, full-bleed, crowded, syncopated, field-dominant list composition and the same duotone/halftone ground. Both stack condensed project titles flush right under a coloured masthead plane. The gold hue and the small-caps standfirst are the only real differences, so a returning visitor would see the October 17 index in a new colour. Break the silhouette: move the index off the right flush or drop the masthead-plane-over-ledger structure. Then change the ground material away from halftone. The gold-on-carbon duotone also sits close to 2026-10-13 (48° burnt gold, duotone), so that trait cannot be the only thing that differs.
